0207-showmances.md::Ryne's rule: what the player knows about someone is only what they saw or were told. (A) `visibleShowmances()` (`GameSessionAdapter`), the one source of the narrator's "Public showmance" fact AND of `getGameState().showmances`, now lists a `visible` pair ("the house knows") only once the player has SEEN it: a `showmance` scene the player was in, or watched from the same room (`romanceSeenBy(PLAYER, a, b)`, the one predicate the own-view reads already use). The house-side event recorded when a pair turns `visible` (`registry.ts` `setOnShowmanceSurfaced`) no longer names the player in its witness set and is hidden: it was putting the pair into `getVisibleState().visibleEvents` and so into the player's knowledge. The prompt line now says "the player has seen or been told". The pair appears when the player later sees it (the list is a pure projection of the record); a scene someone else watched does not list it. The player's own romance is not in this list (it is the player's own acts, `playerShowmance`). No flag: OFF would reintroduce the leak. Not built: a TOLD route. There is no structured romance claim kind in the belief store (`ClaimKind`) and a fact's `subject` is a single houseguest, so a pair a houseguest tells the player of reaches the narrator only through the narrator voicing that scene; the card for a `couple` claim kind (auditor-owned `beliefStore`) is open. Proof: `tests/unit/orw733NarratorShowmanceGate.test.ts` (red on main: the list and the visible state carried the unseen pair), `seededRelationships.test.ts`, `casting_diversity` BDD.

Vault-free; boundary-tested through `McpServer.callTool`. It is NOT named in the narrator prompt, so no five-place FE wiring yet: **follow-up** is the FE screen outside the game and, if wanted, a premiere board line handing the narrator the last seasons as facts.

0209-habits-and-routines.md::- **Authoring chosen:** the engine floor (`floorRoutinesFor` in `houseLife.ts`): two to four routines, each a different act drawn from the action library's ordinary-life acts (derived from `ACTIONS`, not listed; the archetype's lean adds a bonus as the old habit draw did), at a time the act naturally belongs to, in the act's own usual place or a rolled shared room, alone or shared, every part its own keyed `agendaRoll`. Where the cast-authoring habits landed, `routinesFromHabits` maps each to a routine (its own act, one of its own times, strength = the old habit chance), so nothing authored thins. A live model write-back of free-form routines (`gist` words, from the whole backstory) is NOT built: it is the next lane; the floor stands in and says `floor`.

0209-habits-and-routines.md::- **Learning:** when the player is awake in the room a routine puts its holder in, that day counts; on the third separate day the player is handed one third-person fact (the holder's name, the room, the time of day, the authored words or the act) through the knowledge layer as something witnessed, and the narrator words it. Amended from the first sketch: sightings are the player's only (`holder -> key -> days`); NPCs learning where the player usually is, and seeking them there, is a follow-up.

0209-habits-and-routines.md::- **Not built (follow-ups):** the morning anchor (`upBeforeTheCall`, slice 7.1 is not carded: the awake set already refills toward 8am), routine changes with evolution, a hidden mood signal when a routine is broken (the spec asks for none), the NPC-seeks-the-player half.
